sourceArchive.selection: Latest retained revision per template page; documentation, comments, and nowiki examples excluded from dependency names.

definitions.title: Template:DieRoll
definitions.extension: Clickable dice span interpreted by the original wiki's browser code

groups.label: Indefinite articles
groups.requirement: Preserve the archived Article behavior and its Ia alias.
groups.caution: The archived rule handles initial vowels with a uni exception; it is not a general pronunciation engine. Preserve its casing and empty-input behavior.

groups.label: Case conversion
groups.requirement: Support first-character and full-string case conversion through the bounded expression parser.
groups.caution: ucfirst and lcfirst remain ASCII-only at the first character; uc and lc use Unicode casing. Arguments are trimmed, and multiple and nested calls are validated.

groups.label: Pluralization
groups.requirement: Preserve the custom Plural template, including explicit override arguments and its suffix rules.
groups.caution: This is a custom inflection template, not MediaWiki's numeric PLURAL magic word. Do not silently replace its rules with a different inflection library.

groups.label: Possessives
groups.requirement: Preserve existing static po choices and support validated aliases, nested calls, and optional arguments in the wiki evaluator.
groups.caution: The optional second argument overrides only the non-s branch. Terminal s/S, explicit empty arguments, and existing apostrophes follow the archived template.

groups.label: String operations
groups.requirement: Provide literal replacement, substring, forward/reverse position, boundary-aware concatenation, and a literal comma helper.
groups.caution: Concat removes one duplicate boundary character, so ta + al becomes tal. Comma emits comma plus space. Pin negative offsets, missing matches, and argument trimming to source behavior.

groups.label: Arithmetic and number words
groups.requirement: Use bounded arithmetic parsing for #expr and a verified number-word lookup for Numtostring.
groups.caution: Never evaluate source as JavaScript. Numtostring retains the archive's duplicate keys and first-match behavior: 1 yields one while 21 yields an empty result. Arithmetic div means ordinary division and chained powers associate left to right.

groups.label: Conditional expressions
groups.requirement: Provide equality branching with lazy result branches and exact integer-string comparison.
groups.caution: Although directly used by one current table, this capability also underlies many custom template definitions. Avoid evaluating unused branches or rerolling an already evaluated argument.

groups.label: Pronoun tokens
groups.requirement: Replace the template's !HESHE, !HIMHER, and !HISHER tokens for m, f, and z modes.
groups.caution: This is explicit token substitution with sentence capitalization rules, not general grammatical rewriting.

groups.label: Pipe-delimited arrays
groups.requirement: Support the archived pipe-string array representation, append-if-absent behavior, and delimiter rendering.
groups.caution: These are not generic random sampling without replacement; membership uses the source's prefix-search rule. The latest Psychon norepeat operational body matches Array implode despite its name, and is preserved unchanged.

groups.label: Links, tooltips, and colors
groups.requirement: Project presentation templates to their visible plain text without links, tooltips, or color styling.
groups.caution: Fc aliases Font Color. LinkMe retains its text without reproducing the wiki-page-existence presentation; direct #ifexist checks cover registered imported table pages only. Never execute arbitrary HTML, CSS, or URLs from source.

groups.label: Interactive dice control
groups.requirement: Project DieRoll to its explicit text or dice label, defaulting to 1d1; no interactive control or immediate dice roll is created.
groups.caution: DieRoll is an interactive presentation template with named title, dice, and text parameters, not simply an eager random number operation.

groups.label: Current year
groups.requirement: Evaluate CURRENTYEAR using the browser UTC year, with one clock snapshot per roll.
groups.caution: It is a context value, not a template or random choice. Fixed-clock tests cover reproducible output.

groups.label: Generator display wrapper
groups.requirement: Review the original sgdisplay extension and damaged table invocation before attempting support.
groups.caution: The observed table call has an unclosed inner reference, and the archived wrapper uses dynamic template-like syntax. Do not enable it based solely on balanced outer braces.
